note: Version chains preserve amendment history. Only the principal rules — G.S.R. 202(E) dated 7 March 2011, in force from 1 April 2011 — have been supplied and ingested. No amendment notification is available to this engine, so no chain currently displaces a principal-rule provision. When an amendment gazette is ingested, the amended provision is added here as a later entry with its own effective window; the earlier version is retained and given an effective_to date rather than being deleted.
